post.description: Upload invoices (PDF, JPEG, PNG, TIFF, WebP, HEIC) into the manual workspace; the worker reads and checks them.

get.description: Open review tasks: payment-blocking ones first, then by due date (soonest first), then arrival order.

post.description: Replace one value (typed, or picked on the page); the checks run again on the corrected invoice.
Approve, approve the received part, reject, hold or release; every action needs a note.
Queue a fresh read by the model (ignoring the cache); the checks run again when it is done.

get.description: The words found on a page (text layer or OCR), with boxes, so the reviewer can click one to fill a field.
Every payment run (planned and paid) and the items that wait outside a run, with why.
One run: a transfer per vendor and currency, with the invoices (and credit notes) in it.

post.description: Move today to the next planned run (if it's later) and pay it.
Pay every planned run dated today or earlier, oldest first.

put.description: Set the workspace's current date (not while a live inbox is replaying); runs aren't paid until you say so.

get.description: Our companies that have entries in the books (for filtering).
What we owe and haven't paid, aged by due date as of today.
Recompute the workspace's hash chain: any changed, missing or reordered event is found.
